infographic.title: Two Stage Float Switch on a Sump
infographic.alt: Infographic of a two stage float switch on a sump: the pump starts at the first stage, the second stage alarms or shuts off the source, and the pump stops at a lower point
levels: If the level keeps rising, it shuts off the source or raises an alarm.
The shut off point can sit much lower than the turn on point, so the pump cycles less.
